newsitem.title: USA: Auto lead-acid battery group awards two contracts.
newsitem.headline: Auto lead-acid battery group awards two contracts.

text.p: The Advanced Lead-Acid Battery Consortium said it has awarded two new research contracts to produce improved batteries for electric vehicles.
East Penn Manufacturing Co, and Yuasa-Exide Inc were each commissioned to produce cheaper batteries that last longer between charges and need replacing less frequently, the ALABC said.
ALABC has now awarded eight contracts for its new $17.5 million research program.
The organization funds projects to improve lead-acid batteries for use in electric vehicles in face of competition from rival materials such as nickel metal hydride or lithium ion.
Lead acid batteries, mostly used to start autos at present, account for at least 70 percent of the metal's demand.
